explanation: A side-to-side shake of the head means 'yes', the reverse of most countries. In Greece and Türkiye, tilting the head sharply upward means 'no'.

claims.text: In Bulgaria, nodding the head up and down traditionally means 'no'.
In Bulgaria, shaking the head from side to side traditionally means 'yes'.
In most countries a nod means yes and a shake of the head means no.
In Greece and Türkiye, a sharp upward tilt of the head traditionally means 'no'.
